name: Opening And Maintenance Of Public School (Vidya Niketan) For Vimukta Jatis And Nomadic Tribes
benefit:
1. Financial Assistance is given to the institution for maintenance assistance is given on building rent.
1. 100 percent salary grants for approved teaching and non-teaching staff.
1. Students are provided with facilities like books, notebooks, uniforms, education stationary free lodging, and boarding facilities. 
1. ₹1450/- p.m. per residential student is admissible.
_eligibility_text:
1. The beneficiary should be a student.
1. The beneficiary should be a resident of Maharashtra.
1. The beneficiary should belong to the VJNT community.
1. The income of the parents should not be more than Rs. 24000/- per annum.
1. The beneficiary should clear the competitive examination Students belonging to the VJNT category & those who studying in 4th Standard are eligible to take admitted to VJNT Ashram School on a merit basis
